Lemma
[$\bar\lambda $-invariant monotonicity when $\bar\lambda \leq 0$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0399 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants ↗ lem:chow-ii-appd-lambda-monotonicity 1. appD:D.31\group Perelman Invariants

At any time at which $\bar\lambda (g(t))\leq 0$, \[ \frac d{dt}\bar\lambda (g(t))\geq 2\operatorname {Vol}(g(t))^{2/n}\int _{\mathcal M} \left|\operatorname {Ric}+\nabla ^2f- \frac{R+\Delta f}{n}g\right|^2e^{-f}\, d\mu \geq 0, \] where $f$ minimizes $\mathcal F$. Equality implies that $g(t)$ is a gradient Ricci soliton.
